extra_context: We're Scribble Sprouts, a little after-school and weekend art studio for kids ages 4 to 12 here in town. We do painting, clay, collage, the messier the better, and I want the website to feel as joyful and bright as the room does on a Saturday morning when there's glitter everywhere. The one thing parents always mention is our "wall of fame" where every single kid's piece goes up before it goes home, so nobody ever leaves feeling like their art wasn't good enough.
